# FleetCommanderPausable
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/FleetCommanderPausable.sol)

**Inherits:**
Pausable

**Title:**
FleetCommanderPausable

An abstract contract that extends OpenZeppelin's Pausable with a minimum pause time functionality

This contract should be inherited by other contracts that require a minimum pause duration


## State Variables
### minimumPauseTime
The minimum duration that the contract must remain paused


```solidity
uint256 public minimumPauseTime
```


### pauseStartTime
The timestamp when the contract was last paused


```solidity
uint256 public pauseStartTime
```


### MINIMUM_PAUSE_TIME_SECONDS
The minimum duration that the contract must remain paused


```solidity
uint256 constant MINIMUM_PAUSE_TIME_SECONDS = 2 days
```


## Functions
### constructor

Initializes the FleetCommanderPausable contract with a specified minimum pause time


```solidity
constructor(uint256 _initialMinimumPauseTime) ;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_initialMinimumPauseTime`|`uint256`|The initial minimum pause time in seconds|


### _pause

Internal function to pause the contract

Overrides the _pause function from OpenZeppelin's Pausable


```solidity
function _pause() internal override;
```

### _unpause

Internal function to unpause the contract

Overrides the _unpause function from OpenZeppelin's Pausable

Reverts if the minimum pause time has not elapsed


```solidity
function _unpause() internal override;
```

### _setMinimumPauseTime

Internal function to set a new minimum pause time

Emits a MinimumPauseTimeUpdated event


```solidity
function _setMinimumPauseTime(uint256 _newMinimumPauseTime) internal;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_newMinimumPauseTime`|`uint256`|The new minimum pause time in seconds|


## Events
### MinimumPauseTimeUpdated
Emitted when the minimum pause time is updated


```solidity
event MinimumPauseTimeUpdated(uint256 newMinimumPauseTime);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`newMinimumPauseTime`|`uint256`|The new minimum pause time value|

## Errors
### FleetCommanderPausableMinimumPauseTimeNotElapsed
Error thrown when trying to unpause before the minimum pause time has elapsed


```solidity
error FleetCommanderPausableMinimumPauseTimeNotElapsed();
```

### FleetCommanderPausableMinimumPauseTimeTooShort
Error thrown when trying to set a minimum pause time that is too short


```solidity
error FleetCommanderPausableMinimumPauseTimeTooShort();
```
